title: Lipschitz push-forwards of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity, given (S5′) (supplied 2.6, 5.9; parent I.7)
statement: Assume (S5′), verbatim the premise of the parent statement: for all P, Q, k, every X = τ(M, θ, ξ) ∈ D_k(ℝ^P) (IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ, θ natural-valued on M, X(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω for all ω) and every Λ-Lipschitz g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q with g⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X compact for compact K, there is S ∈ D_k(ℝ^Q) with IsLipschitzPushforward X g S, IsIntegerMultiplicity S, and ∫_M θ(x)·nVectorPushforward k (fderiv ℝ g_j x) (ξ x) (ω(g_j x)) dH^k(x) → S(ω) for every sequence of C¹ maps g_j with a common Lipschitz bound converging uniformly to g and every ω. For g : ℝ^p → ℝ^q, ω ∈ D^j(ℝ^q), η ∈ D^j(ℝ^p) and A ⊆ ℝ^p, 'η is compatible with (g, ω) near A' means: there is an open N ⊇ A with η(x) = ω(g(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ g x) for all x ∈ N. For X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} and S ∈ D_k(ℝ^{m′}), LipPF(X, G, S) means: for every sequence (G_n) of C^∞ maps ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)), every open O ⊇ spt X and every L ∈ ℝ such that eventually ‖fderiv ℝ G_n x‖ ≤ L for all x ∈ O, and G_n → G uniformly on O, and for every ω ∈ D^k(ℝ^{m′}) and every sequence (η_n) in D^k(ℝ^m) such that eventually η_n is compatible with (G_n, ω) near spt X, the sequence X(η_n) converges to S(ω). Then for all m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, every integer multiplicity X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, r > 0 such that G is Λ-Lipschitz on thickening r (spt X) and G⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X is compact for every compact K, and every S ∈ D_k(ℝ^{m′}) with LipPF(X, G, S): S is integer multiplicity.
